triage.title: One Leak or Many

triage.detail: 134.3 MB of native memory is held by live DirectByteBuffers — not reflected in the on-heap totals, but counts against process RSS and can trigger OS-level OOM. If RSS grows beyond heap + DirectByteBuffer total, native heap fragmentation may be the cause: repeatedly allocating and freeing differently-sized buffers leaves gaps the allocator cannot reuse for larger requests. Diagnose with `jcmd <pid> VM.native_memory detail`, or use jemalloc heap profiling (`MALLOC_CONF=prof:true`) or async-profiler's malloc mode.
triage.title: Off-Heap (DirectByteBuffer)

triage.detail: 2.7 MB (23.3% of heap) consumed by JVM object headers alone (236,457 objects × 12 B each) — consider replacing wrapper objects with primitive arrays, off-heap buffers, or primitive-specialized collections.
triage.title: Fixed per-Object Header Overhead

triage.detail: 6 of 537 tracked maps (1.1%) have a load factor > 90% — over-packed hash tables cause long collision chains and degrade lookup performance. Increase initial capacity or lower the load factor (pass `initialCapacity` and `loadFactor` to the constructor, default is 0.75).
triage.title: Hash-Map Collision Hotspot

triage.detail: 5,522 of 6,186 tracked collections (89.3%) are empty (1 additional empties are recognized JDK/Scala singleton sentinels — e.g. `scala.Nil$`, `Collections.emptyList()` — expected runtime constants, counted separately in `singleton_sentinels` and excluded from this signal) — pre-allocated but never populated containers waste object-header overhead at scale. Check whether these containers are genuinely never used: allocate on first insert (lazy init) rather than pre-allocating fields that stay empty.
triage.title: Empty-Collection Cemetery

triage.detail: Component `<boot>` retains 76.0% of heap (31.4 MB) while the next largest component (`java/net/URLClassLoader`) retains only 17.1%. In a multi-module or multi-app deployment (OSGi, EE, Tomcat) this imbalance means one component dominates the heap. Investigate whether a class-loader-scoped cache, static field, or event-listener registration in `<boot>` is accumulating without a release path.
triage.title: Component Retention Imbalance

triage.detail: Collection waste not analyzed — re-run with `--collections` to check for wasted capacity.
